correctness.rationale: Exact SU2 covariance transports each site rotation exp(i(4πj/L)S_z) to virtual conjugation; adjacent virtual factors leave a constant δ=4π/L insertion, with V_{4π}=I at the right endpoint. Primitive T0 has analytic simple leading eigenvalue λ(δ). Its derivative i Tr(ρG) vanishes because the unique virtual invariant fixed point ρ commutes with SU2 and every irreducible SU2 spin generator is traceless; hence λ=1+O(δ²). Uniform spectral gap suppresses subleading transfer, and the nonzero fixed boundary norm coefficient yields analytic boundary ratio 1+O(δ); λ(4π/L)^L=1+O(1/L). Independent spin-1 AKLT sample contraction with fixed superposed boundaries gives L|expectation−1| bounded (8.0 to 9.75 for L=20..320), only a finite sanity check.

value.rationale: The squared-twist operator is an established diagnostic, and open-boundary computations are practically important. A general analytic O(L^-1) benchmark across the primitive finite-bond SU2-covariant MPS class with arbitrary fixed nonzero-overlap edge boundaries bridges illustrative AKLT/MG examples and broad Hamiltonian conjectures, without overclaiming either.
